Paragraph: "Hearing Lakshmana's wise and courageous words, Rama collected his thoughts and steadied his mind..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Integrating constructive feedback and emotional support during intense grief.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama actively listens, absorbs Lakshmana's perspective, and stabilizes his mind.
Outcome/Resolution: He achieves emotional balance through receptive listening and self-regulation.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Emotional Regulation: Active Integration, Mind Stabilization, Emotional Re-centering

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Manas-Sthirata (Attaining mental equilibrium through righteous counsel)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Listening to wise counsel (Satsanga) calms the restless mind and restores spiritual alignment.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Receptive emotional processing: integrating supportive feedback to regulate affect and stabilize executive functioning.
